title: fix(studio): object pickers offer only the objects the edited package may reference
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvSmNNn2cV2emnvGXn
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWiWdGBWp9rocznTPtPPZM9)_

Fixes #28240

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 的对象选择器（流程触发对象、流程节点对象、查找字段的关联对象、新建数据集的对象）现在只能选当前软件包可用的对象：自己的、已声明依赖包的、系统对象。范围外的对象放在最后一个默认折叠的分组里，灰显不可选，并说明原因，附「声明依赖」入口，直接打开软件包编辑框；保存后不用刷新即可选。
- 为什么改：发布闸门本来就拒绝范围外的对象，但选择器什么都列，作者在对象上把流程做完，保存后才看到拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：依赖遍历从服务端搬进 `@objectstack/lint` 的 `resolvePackageClosure`，服务端改为调用它，接纳范围不变（服务端原有闭包测试未改、全绿）。软件包列表读不到时不做任何收窄，由服务端判定，与闸门的失败方向一致。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/objectPickerClosure.ts`、`ObjectPicker.tsx` 的分组与禁用逻辑、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-package-scope.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectPicker.closure-28240.test.tsx`，预期 6/6 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/lint`**: new export `resolvePackageClosure(packageId, getPackage)`, on both the root and the `./runtime` entry. It is the dependency walk `resolveWritePackageScope` ran inline, moved verbatim: same guards (no id, the `sys_metadata` sentinel, an unknown package answer `undefined`), same DFS, a declared-but-unresolvable dependency still in the closure, own id skipped. A throwing `getPackage` propagates; the host decides.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: `resolveWritePackageScope` keeps its two host guards (registry without `getPackage`, the silent `catch`) and calls the shared walk. What the gate admits is unchanged.
- **Studio object picker** (`ObjectPicker.tsx`, shared by the flow New dialog's record presets, every flow `object` reference, a lookup's related object and the new-dataset dialog): when a package is being edited, it reads `GET /api/v1/packages` (the request `packages-io.ts` already shares) and lazily imports `@objectstack/lint`, then calls `resolvePackageClosure` and `narrowObjectsToPackageClosure` over the served object list. Neither rule is restated in ui.
  - Objects the closure does not admit are listed last, in a group that starts collapsed ("Show objects outside this package's dependencies (N)"), each `aria-disabled` with "From PACKAGE". A search reaches them without opening the group.
  - The group's first row carries the reason and, when the package is writable, **Declare a dependency**, which opens the package's edit dialog (`PackageFormDialog` mode `edit`). The picker re-reads the closure on `objectui:packages-changed`, so a declared dependency's objects become pickable without a reload.
  - Choosing a disabled row commits nothing. Free-text entry is unchanged (Enter or blur keeps what was typed; the server judges it).
  - No package in scope, the package list unreadable, or the package not listed: nothing is narrowed (the gate's own failure direction).
- **i18n**: six `engine.inspector.objectPicker.*` keys, one contiguous block in each studio pack (en, zh).
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/28240-studio-object-picker-closure.md` (patch: app-shell, i18n, lint, metadata-protocol).

Presentation choice (card item 1, "absent or disabled"): **disabled with the reason and the declare door**, as the seat ruled. A missing object reads as "the platform has no such object"; a disabled one tells the author what to do.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.resolve-package-closure.test.ts` (new): the guards, own-only closure, transitive walk through a cycle, an unresolvable declared dependency kept, a throwing registry propagating, and that the narrow `./runtime` entry names the function.
- `ui/.../inspectors/ObjectPicker.closure-28240.test.tsx` (new), with the real lint functions and only the two reads doubled:
  - **the card repro as a pin**: a package with no dependencies is not offered `showcase_task`; searching finds it disabled, with the reason, and clicking it commits nothing;
  - **CONTROL**: with `com.example.showcase` declared, `showcase_task` is offered and commits;
  - a dependency declared after mount makes the object pickable once the package list changes;
  - platform objects stay pickable with no dependency;
  - the declare row opens the package edit dialog;
  - an unreadable package list narrows nothing.
- `ObjectPicker.test.tsx`: a module-scope `fetch` double for `GET /api/v1/packages` (empty list, so nothing narrows and its expectations are unchanged). The picker now reads that list on mount, and the network-escape guard reds a real socket.

## Verification

Head `3c5e468c` (branch merged with `origin/main`, full rebuild `pnpm turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` 115/115).

- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **64** families; each was run with `</dev/null` and every one exits **0**. Reconciliation `--ran`: `64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is among the 64 (exit 0). `ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (pre-merge head): 169 files, 4901 tests passed.
- Rerun on this head: picker 2 files / 16 tests, lint 4 files / 75 tests, metadata-protocol closure tests 6 files / 382 tests, type-checks (lint, metadata-protocol, i18n, app-shell) exit 0.

<details><summary>Live measure (card item 2, and the picker)</summary>

Own stack: showcase backend `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 41873`; the Console production build (`vite build`) served by `vite preview --port 51874` proxied to it. (The Vite **dev** server cannot load `@objectstack/lint` in the browser, see Acceptance notes, so the picker was measured on the production bundle.)

Item 2, the dependencies editor is reachable from Studio, no wiring needed:
- **New package** (Studio landing, *New package (writable base)*): `package-form-dependencies` visible before *Advanced* = `false`, after expanding *Advanced* = `true`. It sits in the collapsed Advanced section, which is likely why the walkthrough missed it.
- **Package settings** (package chip, *Package info & settings*, *Edit*): `package-form-dependencies` visible = `true`, one row, `com.example.showcase` (declared in the step below).

Item 1, the card's repro on `com.default.acme-custom` (no dependencies), Automations, New, *When a record is created*, Object:
- pickable before search: `sys_inbox_message`, `sys_file`, `sys_upload_session` (platform objects); toggle "Show objects outside this package's dependencies (24)";
- typing `task`: `showcase_task` `aria-disabled="true"`, "From com.example.showcase", reason row "Acme Custom can use only its own objects, …"; clicking it left the input at the typed `task` (nothing committed);
- *Declare a dependency* opened the package edit dialog; adding `com.example.showcase` / `*` and saving closed it; the stored manifest reads `{"com.example.showcase":"*"}`, and the same picker then offered `showcase_task` enabled.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Vite dev Console cannot import `@objectstack/lint` in the browser** (measured on this branch: `Module "module" has been externalized for browser compatibility. Cannot access "module.createRequire" in client code`). The lint graph imports `node:module` in six rule files. In dev the picker therefore narrows nothing and the server judges, the documented failure direction. The production bundle loads it (measured above). The existing in-browser lint callers (`preview/capabilityLint.ts`, `preview/securityPostureLint.ts`, `metadata-admin/celAuthoring.ts`) take the same dynamic import, so they degrade the same way in dev. Not changed here; Refs #28333.
- **Report data source**: a new report binds a dataset, not an object, so its picker is the dataset list and is not narrowed here. A new dataset's object picker is narrowed.
- **Free text stays free**: a name typed and committed with Enter is still saved as typed (flow references may hold expressions), and the server refuses an out-of-closure name at publish as before.
- Card item 3 "the server refusal no longer reachable through the picker" holds for every pick from the list; the free-text path above is the remaining way to reach it, by design.
- File surface: `ObjectPicker.tsx` and the new `objectPickerClosure.ts` live in `views/metadata-admin/inspectors/` (the shared picker every Studio object picker uses), and `packages-io.ts` gains a manifest reader. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is not touched. `packages/lint` and `protocol-write-package-scope.ts` per the seat's claim amendment 6538025413.
